checkedAlternates.risk: Bridle joints look open like a lap joint.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A bridle joint is an open-ended variant of the mortise-and-tenon family (group-4), not a simple lap joint (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: A biscuit acts like a small loose tenon.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Compressed beech biscuits align edge-glued boards (group-1), distinct from structural mortise-and-tenon framing (group-4).
